title: Mythos 5 - World Mythology Intelligence - Greek, Indian, Norse, Egyptian, Panchatantra
description: Like Claude, uses mythos for deep cultural wisdom and archetypes

sisyphus.story: Sisyphus tricked gods, punished to roll boulder uphill forever, it falls each time
sisyphus.lesson: Futile effort without strategy is suffering. Need smart work + purpose, not endless loop. If you're stuck in loop (like overtrading), change strategy.

hercules_12_labors.story: Hercules 12 impossible labors - Nemean lion, Hydra, etc. Each needs different skill
hercules_12_labors.lesson: Big goal broken into 12 labors. Perseverance + learning each skill. For business/startup: each challenge teaches you.

icarus.story: Icarus flew too high with wax wings near sun, wings melted fell
icarus.lesson: Ambition without caution = downfall. For investment: don't leverage too high. Balance ambition with risk management.

prometheus.story: Prometheus stole fire for humans, gave knowledge, punished but humanity progressed
prometheus.lesson: Knowledge sharing is power but has cost. For AI: open source helps humanity.

gita_detachment.story: Krishna to Arjuna: Karmanye vadhikaraste - Do your duty, without attachment to result. Focus on action, not anxiety of result
gita_detachment.lesson: Best for stress, anxiety, investment outcome anxiety, business fear. Do best action, don't over-worry result. This is core emotional management.

ram_dharma.story: Ram left kingdom for 14 years to keep father's promise, endured hardship but kept dharma, eventually became ideal king
ram_dharma.lesson: Short term sacrifice for long term dharma/reputation. In business: ethics over quick profit builds lasting brand.

krishna_leela.story: Krishna as child and diplomat, playful but strategic
krishna_leela.lesson: Balance playfulness + strategy. For leadership: be approachable but smart.

panchatantra_overall.story: Panchatantra 5 books: Mitra Labha, Suhrid Bheda, etc - animal stories teaching niti
panchatantra_overall.lesson: Ancient Indian wisdom for practical life - how to make friends, avoid enemies, use wit. Useful for business, relationships.

thor_hammer.story: Mjolnir only worthy can lift - worthiness = responsibility
thor_hammer.lesson: Power needs worthiness. Leadership, money, AI power needs responsibility.

odin_sacrifice.story: Odin sacrificed one eye for wisdom
odin_sacrifice.lesson: Wisdom has cost. Investment in learning needs sacrifice (time, money) but worth.

ma_at.story: Ma'at goddess of balance, truth, cosmic order vs chaos
ma_at.lesson: Life needs balance - work/life, risk/reward, ambition/ethics. When unbalanced, chaos.

daruma.story: Daruma doll falls 7 times, rises 8 times - persistence
daruma.lesson: Resilience - fall 7 rise 8. Startup, investment loss, failure is part of path.

how_to_use: Use mythos to give depth beyond fable. For stress: Gita detachment. For futile loop: Sisyphus. For greed: Midas/Icarus. For leadership: Ram dharma + Thor worthiness. Connect ancient wisdom to modern problem - Claude-level cultural intelligence.
